# A 100.00 invoice paid exactly, so the payment GnuCash writes carries one
# receivable split and nothing else. Unposting the invoice afterwards leaves
# that split in no lot, which is the shape the owner guard has to answer for
# from the transaction: the split says nothing, and the transaction says
# whose payment it is.
customer "C-EXACT"
	name: "Exact Co"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-EXACT"
	customer_id: "C-EXACT"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		due: 2026-01-31
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-EXACT"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-01-10
		amount: 100
		bank_account: "Assets:Bank"
		memo: "Paid in full"
